aweme_info.desc: We are officially child-free not by choice.  We made the decision about a month ago but took some time before telling people.  To some ~ it might not seem like a big decision ~ but to us ~ it was everything.  The only dream I ever had was motherhood, and Chris fatherhood. After two surgeries, years of trying and multiple IVF loss the weight and pain was too much.  I only don’t think I could carry on mentally and physically and Chris felt the same.  I will be posting about life after making this decision as I have loootts to say and share.  Thank you again to EVERYONE from us both. This account started with our IVF journey.  You helped us more than you know. 🧡 #infertility #infertilecouple #childless #ivf

original_client_text.markup_text:
We are officially child-free not by choice.

We made the decision about a month ago but took some time before telling people.

To some ~ it might not seem like a big decision ~ but to us ~ it was everything.

The only dream I ever had was motherhood, and Chris fatherhood.

After two surgeries, years of trying and multiple IVF loss the weight and pain was too much.

I only don’t think I could carry on mentally and physically and Chris felt the same.

I will be posting about life after making this decision as I have loootts to say and share.

Thank you again to EVERYONE from us both. This account started with our IVF journey.
You helped us more than you know. 🧡

#infertility #infertilecouple #childless #ivf
